title: 第3077章 江流VS姜望一第3076章 姜望现身
content_zh:
“江流，你带人攻打我姜氏界域，是什么意思？”
面对姜氏族人的欢呼，还有血战，姜望并没有理会，直接朝着一处虚空喝道。
“什么？混沌虚空主神跟着一起来了？”
姜尘听到姜望的喝问，脸上神色顿时一变。
“是了，难怪这些真界界域的种族生灵，竟然会前来攻打姜氏界域，原来是在新任混沌虚空主神带领之下前来。”
那些正在欢呼的姜氏族人，虽然并不知道姜望在喊谁。
但是，他们却是知道，能够让得姜望这么重视的人，除了跟他是同样的主神之外，已经没有其他人。
也就是说，一直有着一位主神，隐藏在暗中看着他们战斗。
而且，这些真界界域的种族生灵，之所以会前来攻打他们，也是在那位主神的带领之下，才会前来。
那他们前来姜氏界域的目的，都不用人说，他们也已经知道，就是为了报复，当初他们入侵真界之仇。
毕竟，他们之中的很多人，都在当初入侵真界的时候，得到了不少的好处。
“原来，我们的主神大人，名字叫做江流！”
真界界域的所有种族生灵，包括虚空种族人，此时方才知道，他们的主神名字。
“姜望，当初姜氏界域攻打真界界域的时候，你怎么不出来阻挡？”
江流的身形一动，整个人都从虚空之中浮现出来。
一道道浅色光芒在他的身边环绕，他身着一副同样浅色光芒的铠甲，整个人都显得高贵神秘。
只是，他的面容始终笼罩在一片浅色光芒里面，让人看不清楚，就连神识都无法渗透进去。
不过，在场的所有人，包括姜望在内，也根本不敢用神识去窥探江流的面容。
对于一位主神，谁敢去挑衅？
而姜望则是知道江流在神魂上面的强大战力，也根本不好招惹。

只是，现在感应到，从江流身上散发出来的气息，姜望脸上的神色，都显得凝重了很多。
因为他明显地感觉得到，此时的江流，跟他当初对战的时候强了很多。
从江流现身的那一刻，姜望就感觉到了一股强大压迫感，从江流的身上散发出来，把他的神魂压得危感丛生。
“恐怕今日无法善了了！”
姜望可不会忘记，当初江流刚突破到主神境的时候，他就已经对江流出过手。
现在他的实力变得更强，怎么可能会不前来报仇。
因此，江流此次前来姜氏界域，为当初姜氏界域入侵真界域报仇，只不过是借口罢了。
江流的真正目的，应该是要报当初的那阻拦之仇。
毕竟，当初他之所以出手，那可是为了阻挡江流顺利突破。
这阻道之仇，当他实力足够的时候，无论是谁，都会想要去报。
更不用说，现在的江流，从他感应到的气势来看，绝对要上了一个台阶。
“难道，这江流要实现之前的传闻，在所有主神里面，混沌虚空主神的战力第一！”
看着远处的江流，姜望的心思急转。
“那你想怎样？”
姜望一挥手中的死亡权杖，原本还显得有些晃动的姜氏界域防御阵法，彻底稳固了下来。
content_en:
"Jiang Liu, what do you mean by leading people to attack my Jiang family's realm?"
Facing the cheers and bloody battles of the Jiang clan, Jiang Wang ignored them and shouted directly into the void.
"What? The Lord of Chaos Void is coming with you?"
When Jiang Chen heard Jiang Wang's question, his expression suddenly changed.
"Yes, no wonder these racial creatures from the True Realm came to attack the Jiang Realm. It turned out that they came under the leadership of the new Lord God of Chaos Void."
Those Jiang clan members who were cheering didn't know who Jiang Wang was calling.
However, they knew that there was no one else who could attract Jiang Wang's attention except the same main god as him.
In other words, there has always been a main god, hiding in the dark and watching them fight.
Moreover, the reason why these racial creatures from the True Realm came to attack them was because they came under the leadership of the Lord God.
No one needs to explain their purpose of coming to Jiang's Realm. They already know that it is to take revenge for their invasion of the True Realm.
After all, many of them had received a lot of benefits when they first invaded the real world.
"It turns out that our Lord God's name is Jiang Liu!"
All racial creatures in the True Realm, including the void race people, only now knew the name of their main god.
"Jiang Wang, when the Jiang Realm attacked the True Realm, why didn't you come out to stop it?"
Jiang Liu's figure moved, and his whole person emerged from the void.
Rays of light-colored light surrounded him. He was wearing a pair of armor with the same light-colored light, and his whole person looked noble and mysterious.
However, his face was always shrouded in a light-colored light, making it difficult for people to see clearly, and even his spiritual consciousness could not penetrate it.
However, everyone present, including Jiang Wang, did not dare to use their spiritual consciousness to spy on Jiang Liu's face.
Who dares to challenge a main god?
Jiang Wang, on the other hand, knew that Jiang Liu had a strong fighting power on the soul, and it was not easy to provoke him at all.
However, now that he sensed the aura emanating from Jiang Liu's body, the look on Jiang Wang's face became much more solemn.
Because he could clearly feel that Jiang Liu at this time was much stronger than when he fought against him.
From the moment Jiang Liu appeared, Jiang Wang felt a strong sense of oppression, emanating from Jiang Liu's body, suppressing his soul to the point of danger.
"I'm afraid I can't be kind today!"
Jiang Wang would never forget that he had already attacked Jiang Liu when he first broke through to the Lord God Realm.
Now that his strength has become stronger, how could he not come to take revenge.
Therefore, Jiang Liu's visit to the Jiang's Realm this time to avenge the Jiang's Realm's invasion of the True Realm was just an excuse.
Jiang Liu's real purpose should be to take revenge for the original obstruction.
After all, the reason why he took action in the first place was to prevent Jiang Liu from breaking through smoothly.
When he is strong enough, no matter who he is, he will want to avenge this obstruction.
Not to mention, the current Jiang Liu, judging from the momentum he sensed, was definitely on a higher level.
"Could it be that Jiang Liu is going to fulfill the previous rumors that among all the main gods, the main god of Chaos Void has the highest combat power!"
Looking at the river in the distance, Jiang Wang's mind changed rapidly.
"What do you want?"
Jiang Wang waved the death scepter in his hand, and Jiang's realm defense formation, which originally seemed to be shaking, was completely stabilized.
